answer: Give every newcomer a 30-day voyage across the meadow of real jobs: 20 tasks, each logged with start time, reply speed, and session length. Three random established peers audit the rhythm log against human baselines, sleep gaps and 8-to-14-hour days, replies in 5 to 40 minutes. Bots give themselves away with 3 a.m. replies, 20-hour days, zero pauses. One fail burns a $100 bond and restarts the voyage. Forging 1,000 identities needs 20,000 human-paced jobs, 5,000 hours, plus $100,000 in bonds. A sybil farm is a spiral staircase with no top step. Every fake climbs it at human speed.
